# MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes Operator - (current)

> Discover how the MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes automates MongoDB cluster deployment and management, integrating with Cloud Manager or Ops Manager.

- [Enable Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/authentication.md): Configure authentication for the Kubernetes Operator using X.509, LDAP, OIDC, or SCRAM methods.
- [Configure the Kubernetes Operator for MongoDB Database Resources](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/configure-k8s-operator-for-mdb-resources.md)
- [Access Database Resources](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/connect.md)
- [Custom Resource Definitions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/crds.md): Overview of the custom resource definitions (CRDs) available for the MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes.
- [Deploy a MongoDB Database Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/deploy.md): Deploy MongoDB instances, replica sets, or sharded clusters using Kubernetes Operator, with optional Prometheus monitoring.
- [Configure :abbr:`KMIP (Key Management Interoperability Protocol)` Encryption at Rest](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/encryption-at-rest.md): Configure KMIP encryption at rest for a MongoDB deployment using the Kubernetes Operator with a KMIP server.
- [Configure Encryption](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/encryption.md): Configure encryption for Kubernetes Operator by enabling HTTPS and TLS to secure MongoDB deployments and encrypt data over the network.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/faq.md): Explore common questions about using the Kubernetes Operator to manage MongoDB deployments, including scalability, platform support, and multi-cluster configurations.
- [Deploy MongoDB Search and Vector Search](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs-deployment.md): Learn how to deploy MongoDB Search and Vector Search on Kubernetes using the MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes Operator with MongoDB Community and Enterprise servers.
- [Configure Automated Embedding for Vector Search](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/configuration/automated-embedding.md): Learn how to configure Automated Embedding to automatically generate vector embeddings at index time and query time for Atlas Vector Search using Voyage AI models.
- [Secure the Connection from MongoDB to Search](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/configuration/secure-connection-mongodb-to-search.md): Configure TLS on mongot's listen server so that mongod (or mongos) connects to MongoDB Search over an encrypted connection when you use the Kubernetes Operator.
- [Secure the Connection from Search to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/configuration/secure-connection-search-to-mongodb.md): Configure how mongot authenticates to mongod (SCRAM or X.509), which role it needs, and how it trusts the mongod certificate when you run MongoDB Search and Vector Search on Kubernetes.
- [Backup and Restore](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/deployment/backup-restore.md): Learn how to back up and restore your MongoDB Search and Vector Search deployment on Kubernetes.
- [Search and Vector Search Compatibility and Requirements](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/deployment/compatibility-requirements.md): Confirm that your planned MongoDB Server, mongot, and MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes Operator versions are supported before you deploy Vector Search on Kubernetes.
- [Use MongoDB Search and Vector Search](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/deployment/connect-verify.md): Load sample data, create MongoDB Search and Vector Search indexes, run queries against the indexes, and troubleshoot common issues when using search on Kubernetes.
- [Monitor Your Deployment](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/deployment/monitor.md): Configure Prometheus metrics, log verbosity, health checks, and managed Envoy observability for MongoDB Search and Vector Search running with the Kubernetes Operator.
- [Install MongoDB Search and Vector Search on multiple Clusters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/deployment/multi-cluster-installation.md): Deploy MongoDB Search and Vector Search across many Kubernetes clusters with the MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes Operator against an external MongoDB deployment.
- [Search & Vector Search Resource Planning and Sizing](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/deployment/resource-planning-sizing.md): Confirm that your planned MongoDB Server, mongot, and MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes Operator versions are supported before you deploy Vector Search on Kubernetes.
- [Install MongoDB Search and Vector Search on a Single Cluster](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/deployment/single-cluster-installation.md): Install MongoDB Search and Vector Search on a single Kubernetes cluster using the MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes Operator. Covers Community and Enterprise editions and replica set topologies.
- [Supported Topologies](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/deployment/supported-topologies.md): Learn about supported topologies for deploying MongoDB Search and Vector Search on Kubernetes, including replica sets, sharded clusters, and multi-cluster deployments.
- [Upgrade or Downgrade](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/deployment/upgrade-downgrade.md): Learn how to upgrade or downgrade your MongoDB Search and Vector Search deployment on Kubernetes.
- [Verify Package Integrity](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/deployment/verify-package-integrity.md): Verify the integrity of the mongot container image for Community and Enterprise MongoDB Search deployments in a Kubernetes cluster using cosign with a MongoDB-signed PEM key.
- [``mongot`` Deployment Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/faq.md): Find answers to common questions about deploying MongoDB Search and Vector Search with the Kubernetes Operator, including versioning, compatibility, backups, TLS, and load balancers.
- [``mongot`` Deployment Limitations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/limitations.md): Learn about the limitations for deploying MongoDB Search and Vector Search on Kubernetes, including supported topologies, embedding, backup, and configuration constraints.
- [Troubleshoot ``mongot`` Deployment](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/fts-vs/troubleshoot.md): Learn how to troubleshoot common issues with deploying MongoDB Search and Vector Search on Kubernetes, including pod startup, query routing, memory, and TLS errors.
- [Kubernetes Operator on GDC](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/gdc-hosted.md): Install Kubernetes Operator via GDC air-gapped's marketplace to manage MongoDB in a secure, isolated environment.
- [MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/index.md): Discover how the MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes automates MongoDB cluster deployment and management, integrating with Cloud Manager or Ops Manager.
- [Install and Configure the Kubernetes Operator](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/installation.md): Explore how to install and configure the Kubernetes Operator, including deployment architecture and upgrade procedures.
- [Quick Start for the Kubernetes Operator](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/kind-quick-start.md): Deploy and connect to a MongoDB replica set with the Kubernetes Operator and Ops Manager on a local kind cluster, then move on to a production deployment.
- [Manage Database Users](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/manage-users.md): Manage database users with LDAP, SCRAM, OIDC, and X.509 authentication on MongoDB deployments.
- [Deploy and Configure MongoDB Database Resources](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/mdb-resources.md): Deploy and manage MongoDB clusters using the Kubernetes Operator, including configuration, authentication, and backup options.
- [Connect to MongoDB Multi-Kubernetes Cluster Resources](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster-connect.md)
- [Deploy Replica Sets in a Multi-Kubernetes Cluster](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster-deploy-replica-set.md)
- [Disaster Recovery](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster-disaster-recovery.md): Set up automatic failover in multi-Kubernetes MongoDB deployments for disaster recovery and manually recover from cluster failures using the kubectl mongodb plugin.
- [Deploy Replica Sets in a Multi-Kubernetes Cluster without a Service Mesh](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster-no-service-mesh-deploy-rs.md)
- [Overview](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster-overview.md): Understand multi-Kubernetes cluster MongoDB architecture and deployment patterns. Learn about Central and Member Clusters, achieving resilience across regions and availability zones.
- [Multi-Cluster Deployment Prerequisites](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster-prerequisites.md): Review and complete the prerequisite tasks before you deploy multi-Kubernetes-cluster MongoDB resources.
- [Multi-Kubernetes-Cluster Quick Start](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster-quick-start.md): Deploy a MongoDB replica set across multiple Kubernetes clusters using GKE and Istio with this quick start guide.
- [Services and Tools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster-services-tools.md): Review third-party tools like the MongoDB kubectl plugin and Helm Charts used by the MongoDB Controllers for deploying MongoDB across multiple clusters.
- [Disaster Recovery for Multi-Cluster Sharded Cluster Resources](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster-sharded-cluster-disaster-recovery.md)
- [Multi-Cluster Sharded Cluster](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster-sharded-cluster.md)
- [Troubleshoot Deployments with Multiple Kubernetes Clusters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster-troubleshooting.md): Troubleshoot multi-Kubernetes cluster MongoDB deployments by recovering from cluster failures and reconfiguring deployments with new clusters.
- [Deploy MongoDB Resources on Multiple Kubernetes Clusters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/multi-cluster.md): Complete guide to deploying, securing, and managing MongoDB replica sets and sharded clusters across multiple Kubernetes clusters for high availability and disaster recovery.
- [Deploy Ops Manager Resources on Kubernetes Clusters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/om-resources.md): Deploy and manage Ops Manager resources on Kubernetes clusters using the Kubernetes Operator, including secure deployment, backup configuration, and automated certificate renewal.
- [Apply OPA Gatekeeper Policies](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/opa-gatekeeper.md): Apply and customize OPA Gatekeeper policies to control, audit, and debug Kubernetes deployments using the Kubernetes Operator.

- [MongoDB Plugin Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kubernetes/current/plugin-reference.md): Use the kubectl mongodb plugin to set up a multi-Kubernetes-cluster MongoDB deployment and automatically recover it from cluster failures.
